verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is a hosted process-guidance service that agents connect to. It "runs no model" and publishes its own MCP server for agent hosts to consume, so acting as an MCP client that loads other servers' tools is outside its product role. Its server-side MCP endpoint is a different role and earns no credit here, and nothing in the evidence shows it consuming third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
